info.name: Grafana Delete Dashboard Snapshot By Delete Key

items.docs: This API operation allows you to remove a dashboard snapshot from Grafana using its unique delete key. When a snapshot is created, it generates a special delete key that provides authorized deletion access without requiring authentication. By making a GET request to this endpoint with the appropriate deleteKey parameter, the associated snapshot will be permanently removed from the system.
